area_overview(): 全部FAO海洋渔区概览

Source: vignettes/articles/zh/reference/area_overview.Rmd
area_overview.Rmd

英文原页：area_overview()

说明

该函数对比各FAO主要海洋渔区：各渔区渔获量随时间的变化、峰值年份、最后一年渔获量占峰值的百分比，以及近期趋势（见peak_trend()）。

English

This function compares the FAO major marine fishing areas: their catch over time, peak year, catch in the last year as a percentage of the peak, and recent trend (see peak_trend()).

用法 

area_overview(
  recent_years = 10,
  plot = TRUE,
  table = TRUE,
  lang = NULL,
  pptx = getOption("faofishingreport.pptx", FALSE),
  data_version = "latest"
)

参数

recent_years
计算趋势所用的最近年数。默认为10。
English The number of most recent years used for the trend. Default is 10.
plot
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，图表保存在figures/png/summary/。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), charts are saved in figures/png/summary/.
table
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，表格保存在tables/。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), tables are saved in tables/.
lang
图表文字和名称的语言：“en”（英文）、“zh”（中文）或”both”（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用fao_settings()设置的语言（未更改时为”en”）。
English The language of the chart text and names: “en” (English), “zh” (Chinese) or “both” (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with fao_settings() (“en” unless changed).
pptx
逻辑值。为TRUE时，图表还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件，保存在figures/pptx/summary/。默认为FALSE，可以用fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)为所有函数统一更改。
English A logical value. If TRUE, charts are also saved as editable PowerPoint files in figures/pptx/summary/. Default is FALSE, which can be changed for all functions with fao_settings(pptx = TRUE).
data_version
使用的FAO数据版本；见fishing_area_data()。默认为”latest”。
English The FAO data release to use; see fishing_area_data().

返回值

以不可见方式返回一个数据框，每个渔区一行（第一行为总渔获量）。

English

Invisibly, a data frame with one row per area (the first row is the total).

另请参阅

Other summary analyses: coastal_distant(), country_group_summary(), data_quality(), diversity_concentration(), peak_trend(), regime_shift(), species_group_composition(), stock_status()

示例 

area_overview(lang = "zh")
